title: The Cloud Cotton-Modal Lounge Shorts
description:
You adored our Linen Shorts, so we crafted a cozy loungewear and PJ version just for you! Enjoy a stretchy elastic waistband and high-rise design that guarantee comfort all day (and night!).

  • Generous fabric around the hips and wide leg openings create a flattering silhouette.
  • Deep pockets easily fit your large phone, while reinforced crotch seams ensure lasting durability.
  • Made in Canada with buttery soft and breathable cotton/modal blend jersey
  • They pair perfectly with with The Cloud Cotton-Modal Long Sleeve Top and The Reversible Embrace Bra.

title: The Cloud Cotton-Modal High Rise Joggers
description:
Our beloved joggers are now available in a lighter weight option! The stretchy, elastic-free high waist stays comfy all day long (maternity and bloat friendly!). They are perfect for lounging, working out and everything in between!

  • Mid-weight modal/cotton jersey keeps you cool and comfortable
  • Flatlock stitching and diamond gusset for chafe-free wear
  • Perfect for sleeping, lounging, and light exercise
  • Pair them with our matching Embrace Bras or The Cloud Cotton-Modal Long Sleeve Top for a cohesive look!
  • Crafted with care in Canada

title: The French Terry Bamboo High Rise Leggings
description:
These high-waisted leggings hug you in all the right ways, never constrict your belly or slide down, and feel even better than wearing nothing. You'll never feel so comfortable in your own skin!

  • Luxurious seamless high waist feels like a warm hug. These are great for maternity and postpartum.

  • Made in Canada with ultra soft and breathable Oeko-Tex Standard 100 natural fibre fabric derived from bamboo and cotton

title: The Cloud Cotton-Modal Reversible Embrace Bra
description:
This game-changing bra will have you ditching all your other bras and wishing you found it sooner. 

Say goodbye to rigid wires, thin bra straps, too tight elastic, scratchy seams, awkward clasps and bulky built in padding ... And hello to unbelievable comfort!

    • Reversible - wear with a low neckline (nursing friendly), or flip around for some extra coverage (no more falling out in downward dogs!)

    • Underwire-free, hardware-free and elastic-free for ultimate comfort (even when snuggling with baby or sleeping)

    • Double layered for support and seamless finishing for comfort

    • Broad straps/ no racer back is the most comfortable on your shoulders and won’t cause neck pain or headaches
    • The minimalist design allows it to be folded to take up very little space. Perfect for travel!

    • Low neckline side gathers in the middle and has pockets for optional removable foam cups (sold separately)

    • This is a low to medium support bra, not intended for running or high impact activities - but is perfect for literally everything else!

    • Made in Canada with buttery soft cotton/modal jersey *except the Cream colour is bamboo/cotton*
